attributes.label: movement
attributes.about: The lifter's word for a bundle of joint actions; the joint attributes say where and how; a push-up is a press, and a push drives a sled over the floor

attributes.label: kind
attributes.about: What kind of activity it is

attributes.label: joints
attributes.about: Which joints move; tick every one that moves, as a squat ticks hip and knee and an RDL only the hip

attributes.label: hip
attributes.about: What the thigh does on the pelvis

attributes.label: knee
attributes.about: What the knee does

attributes.label: ankle
attributes.about: What the foot does

attributes.ask: What does the upper arm do?
attributes.label: shoulder
attributes.about: What the upper arm does

attributes.label: elbow
attributes.about: What the elbow does: one joint, opposite muscles

attributes.label: spine
attributes.about: What the trunk does

attributes.ask: What does the shoulder blade do?
attributes.label: scapula
attributes.about: What the shoulder blade does on its own

attributes.label: wrist
attributes.about: What the wrist does against the load

attributes.label: neck
attributes.about: What the head does on the trunk

attributes.label: load
attributes.about: What resists, several at once when it is so

attributes.label: machine
attributes.about: Which machine: how a resistance machine loads, or which cardio machine holds you in place

attributes.label: model
attributes.about: The model, only when the title names one
values: Body Masters Plate Loaded Squat Press
Hammer Strength Ground Base Squat / High Pull

attributes.label: bar
attributes.about: Which bar: its shape sets how the hands face or where the load sits

attributes.label: attachment
attributes.about: What the hands hold on a cable; it fixes the elbow path

attributes.ask: Where does the load, or a pad moving with it, meet the body?
attributes.label: load at
attributes.about: A hack squat's shoulder pads and back pad both move with the load, so both count as on the shoulders

attributes.ask: Which way does the load travel?
attributes.label: direction
attributes.about: Where the load travels relative to the torso, whatever the bench does; blank where it separates nothing

attributes.ask: What travels, the load or the body?
attributes.label: moves
attributes.about: What travels, the body or the load: closed or open chain

attributes.label: posture
attributes.about: How the body is arranged

attributes.label: on
attributes.about: What the body rests on; blank when standing, the floor being what standing means, and one value only, what the raised or supported part rests on

attributes.ask: What angle is your torso at?
attributes.label: torso angle
attributes.about: The line from your hips to your shoulders: flat is level, upright is straight up, 45° is halfway, and shoulders below hips is decline; on an adjustable bench, use the bench's number

attributes.ask: Which way do the handles go as you push or pull?
attributes.label: handles
attributes.about: As a whole, even if they swing on an arm; any rise or fall you can see counts as up or down; if the back pad leans back, read it as if the pad were straight up

attributes.label: hands at
attributes.about: Handles, dumbbells or parallettes mean one under each hand; a bench, box, bar, counter, wall or one dumbbell under both hands counts as up on something

attributes.label: feet at
attributes.about: Where your toes rest; a bench, box, step, ball, wall or straps count as up on something

attributes.ask: Which body parts press against something that stays still?
attributes.label: braced
attributes.about: Like your chest on a row's pad or your thighs under a pulldown's pad; not against the load or a pad moving with it, as on a hack squat; not feet you stand on; not muscles you tighten to hold still, which are stabilizers

attributes.label: stance
attributes.about: How the feet are placed; blank where it separates nothing

attributes.ask: How high on the platform are the feet?
attributes.label: platform
attributes.about: How high on the platform the feet sit on a leg press, hack squat, V-squat or the like; blank where the feet are on a bar or the floor

attributes.label: start
attributes.about: From the top if the load is in the air at the bottom of a rep, as on an RDL, a swing or a hang clean; otherwise from where it touches down

attributes.ask: How do the two sides move?
attributes.label: sides
attributes.about: How the two sides move

attributes.label: grip
attributes.about: How the hand faces

attributes.ask: How far apart are the hands?
attributes.label: hands
elbows
attributes.about: Where the elbow travels on a row, as a trainer cues it

attributes.label: elbow at
attributes.about: Where the held elbow sits on a curl or an extension

attributes.ask: Which way does the foot step?
attributes.label: step
attributes.about: Lunges only: which way the moving foot steps out from standing

attributes.label: travel
attributes.about: Whether you end where you started or cover ground

attributes.label: type
attributes.about: One exercise, or an ordered sequence done as one

attributes.label: target
attributes.about: The muscles the exercise trains, by role

attributes.label: synergists
attributes.about: the synergists, muscles that help the leads at the same joint or nearby, e.g. the brachialis on a curl, the glutes on an RDL

attributes.label: stabilizers
attributes.about: muscles that hold a joint still so the others can move, e.g. the erectors and core on a bent-over row
